title: Bloke Knitwear
description: A custom Shopify site for bespoke knitwear brand creating high quality 1/1 handmade pieces with several collections released per year. This project is being developed in phases in collaboration with the Bloke founder. Phase 1 of the website has been completed.

title: Weather Report
description: 19x30in poster design for Mackenzie Huber and July Guzman's collaborative art show featuring new work at the Bolinas Gallery. The artists did not wish to feature their work as imagery for the design. Instead, objects relating to their concept were sourced and photographed for this project. A short animated version was made for social media.

title: Proof Lab Site
description: Shopify site and studio photography for Proof Lab Surf Shop working closely with owner Will Hutchinson. Thank you Mike McKay for photography consulting.

title: Walk St. Helena
description: NG2 was approached by St. Helena Community members to design a 100 page report outlining improvements for walking trails and open space in the City of St. Helena. A straightforward visual identity and graphic approach was developed to structure this document. This project was created in collaboration with David Knudsen along with several other community members- with oversite given by experienced landscape architect Joe Runco (SWA Group).

title: Regular Beach
description: Regular Beach is a brand, arts collective and media library building community in design and visual arts among other things. Visit the website to view ongoing projects.

title: Groundworks Office
description: Graphic design production for Groundworks Office Landscape Architecture marketing pursuits, creating extensive qualifications packages following existing brand guidelines. All content and photography developed by Groundworks Office. Reach out for more information.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
description: Poster and postcard concept designed with Tamar Rogoff and Sara Gierc for Rogoff's multimedia theater production at La MaMa in NYC.

title: Shakespeare on the Water
description: Rebranding and event graphics for a Sausalito theater company hosting various programming and workshops.

title: Hendrix Park
description: Hendrix Park is a one-person sewing studio making clothing with vintage industrial machines in Sausalito, CA. This is an ongoing collaboration that has so far included a woven Label graphic, flexible logomark, and screenprinted hangtags.

title: 25th CMG Party
description: Animated Invitation celebrating CMG Landscape Architecture's 25th year in Business.

title: RB @ Pretty Gritty
description: Two posters to promote the label, Regular Beach, for a pop-up event at Pretty Gritty gallery in San Francisco. 24x38in.

title: Marin Nicotine Prevention Program
description: A new logomark for a Marin County based program part of the non-profit, Bay Area Community Resources (BACR). Designed to be a public facing identity used for signage, flyers, events and other promotional material.

title: The Farm Diary
description: Web design and development for a portfolio which documents 5 years of managing and restoring a historic vineyard property in Sonoma, CA. Password required for full access. Please contact for permissions.

title: ZMDF
description: Identity System for Zac Mosher Design & Fabrication (ZMDF).

title: Schank Builders
description: Identity and graphic design for family owned construction management and general contracting company Schank Builders (formerly Pacific Construction Managers) located in Santa Cruz, CA.

title: Elevated Weaving
description: A special visual identity project for the tree net builders at Elevated Weaving. Starting out in the Oak and Redwood trees of Northern California, this crew is a leader in innovative net building and design.

title: Independent July 27
description: Poster design for a sold out show at the Independent July 27th, 2024.

title: EWEB & Every Thing Live
description: Poster Design for a night of super cool music at the Independent in San Francisco. The process for this design started with photographing sea shells at the beach.

title: Bolinas HRDWR
description: Poster for a night of music at the Bolinas Hardware Store, August 2023. The design went through a process of digital and analog manipulation before being printed on Kraft paper and pinned up around town. It was also featured on the cover of the Bolinas Hersay News that week in collaboration with Oliver Whitcroft.

title: Rattlecan Pale Ale
description: Rattlecan Pale Ale is a fictional identity completed in the Graphic Design 3 course with professor Lihn Dao at Cal Poly SLO. The idea for this project involved blending aesthetics of lo-brow and craft beers to create an approachable but refined Pale Ale. The Keywords, 8-hour-shift, and Sunday-drive were used to fuel the concept.
